description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Recent Sequence Ratio and Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio. The x-axis is labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. The left y-axis is labeled "Perplexity" and has a linear scale ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The right y-axis is labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 40 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 10. A dashed orange line, labeled "Perplexity", begins at approximately 4.63 when the Recent Sequence Ratio is 0, decreases to a minimum of approximately 4.32 when the Recent Sequence Ratio is 40, and then increases to approximately 4.62 when the Recent Sequence Ratio is 100. A dashed brown line, labeled "Full Cache PPL", is horizontal at approximately 4.35 across the entire range of the x-axis. A solid blue line, labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio", begins at approximately 42 when the Recent Sequence Ratio is 0, increases steadily to approximately 53 when the Recent Sequence Ratio is 60, and then increases sharply to approximately 93 when the Recent Sequence Ratio is 100. A dashed gray line, labeled "Full Cache GPU Mem.", is horizontal at approximately 60 across the entire range of the x-axis.
